result.stdout:
murder-mod-install -- Murder Engine mod loader installer

Commands:
  murder-mod-install <game-dir> [sdk-dir]         Install mod loader into a game
  murder-mod-install build <mod-dir> <game-dir>   Build and install a mod from source
  murder-mod-install add <source> <game-dir>      Install a mod from NuGet, git, or zip

Sources for 'add':
  nuget:<package-id>          NuGet package (latest version)
  nuget:<package-id>@<ver>    NuGet package (specific version)
  git:<url>                   Git repository
  https://.../*.zip           Zip file URL (direct download)
  /path/to/mod.zip            Local zip file

Supports both flat game directories and macOS .app bundles.
